Remark
[submetries are $C^{1,1}$, sharply]

Source: petersen:page-0220, petersen:page-0221 ↗ thm:pet-ch5-berestovskii-submetry 1. ch5:5.6.17Submetries are in fact $C^{1,1}$ (locally Lipschitz derivative), via local Lipschitz continuity of $\tilde p\mapsto \bar q$; this cannot be improved in general, e.g. for $K=[0,1]^2\subset \mathbb R^2$ the level sets of $r(x)=|xK|$ are rounded squares with quarter-circle corners, not $C^2$.
